yorum: If you want to ruin your vacation, this hotel is the perfect choice. Be prepared for endless frustration from the moment you arrive. If you plan to spend time at the beach, make sure to reserve your sunbed well in advance—otherwise, don’t expect to find one available. The biggest disappointment, however, was the hotel manager. He was extremely rude, unprofessional, and clearly doesn’t know how to treat guests with basic respect. Instead of helping, he made every interaction unpleasant. Definitely not the level of service you would expect from a hotel. I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

We truly enjoyed our stay at the highlight in June We got there late into the night after a very hectic few days in Istanbul. The manager at the hotel was extremely nice and accommodating . One of the rooms had a musty smell , and I asked for the room to be changed and be next door to ours since our kids were staying in that room. The next day they had one of their two bedroom suits ready for us which was amazing. The staff were extremely polite and professional. The hotel is beautiful very quaint and kept very nicely. And the water was like your private beach. Very calm and just the right number of people. We definitely will go back .

This summer we took a family vacation to Turkey to visit friends in Bodrum. The Highlights Hotel exquisitely accommodated us throughout our stay. The service was excellent, and the staff were kind and welcoming. The food was delicious and abundant, and the drinks were lavish! Not to mention the great music the DJ played throughout the day. They truly stopped at nothing to accommodate us including removing a floor board to retrieve a lost diamond ring. Thank you for a great stay, we’ll be back again next summer!

I visit the hotel's beach club every year and unfortunately gets worse every year. The beach and the sea is one of the best, it had a sandy beach and crystal clear sea. The music and the setting is great. The food is really bad; I ordered a well sonr steak , it was rare to medium, the vegetables were greasy, the waiters were not interested in serving. The hotel and the beach toilets were dirty. Before I left, I shared my feedback with the manager on duty but he did not care much.

A Perfect Vacation Experience in the Heart of Bodrum! I spent my most enjoyable vacation in Bodrum here. I enjoyed every moment with the hotel's magnificent view, clean rooms and peaceful atmosphere. Thanks to its seafront location, it was unique to wake up to the deep blue view in the morning. The staff were extremely attentive and helpful in every way; they made me feel special. The variety of breakfasts and dinners were absolutely scrumptious. I highly recommend it for those looking for silence, quality and comfort. My indispensable address in Bodrum is now clear.

This is in fact not a hotel anymore, but only a small part of an incredibly noisy entertainment facility, so called "X Beach" ! The "ear drilling" music from thousands watt speakers starts in the morning and never - never stops, not even a single minute! Hundreds of customers visiting "X Beach" everyday drink all the day, dance and scream each other. No chance to find any sunbeds for the hotel guests as they are always reserved for X Beach customers. All the dining facilities are controlled by "X-Beach" , extremely poor quality with sky high prices.

Our stay at Highlight hotel was due to my parents staying close by and would not repeat ever again. The hotel is careful only to its beach club customers whereas we guest staying at the hotel are treated second class. Breakfast is rich but the same ever day and becomes tedious at the end of the week especially because my kids don't like or eat the typical Turkish breakfast, they were not even given an option. Overall the beach of the hotel is good but the rest lacks in every sense...

This is the worst establishment I've ever seen. It's a shame such a beautiful location and sea can be managed so poorly. First of all, the hotel lacks professional management. Therefore, it's impossible to find someone to explain your situation to. We drove to the front of the hotel and waited for someone to take our suitcases, but unfortunately, no one came. We didn't worry about it, thinking it was due to the crowds. We carried our suitcases up the stairs ourselves to the reception. There, we were greeted by Mr. Dogus, who introduced himself as the front desk manager. He completed our check-in process and escorted us to a larger room. He took us to a building outside the main hotel area, which we later realized was a different building altogether. The room they gave us was basically an apartment, not even a room phone to call reception. When we went to reception and requested a room change, we were unfortunately told that everyone else loved the room and we were the only ones who didn't. Afterwards, they showed us the room you can see in the attached photos; this was the room we thought we had paid for. I specifically wanted to include both the internet photos and the actual room because when we expressed our dissatisfaction with this room, a sales manager suggested we should look at the descriptions below the photos instead. We were at fault for making this reservation based on the photos. To this point, no one has apologized for this experience. When we thanked them and informed them that we did not wish to stay, they stated that they could not refund the cost of two days out of our four-day stay, explaining that this was the reason for taking the deposit. Unfortunately, since we didn't want to leave our payment inside, we were forced to use the room. To use the TV in the room, we needed to connect to the internet. We called reception, and they suggested we use our own phone's Wi-Fi. We couldn't believe it! It was truly unbelievable that they suggested we use our own internet to use the TV they put in the hotel room. Since the main lights in the room couldn't be switched off, we had to turn them off when we went to bed and turn them back on when we woke up. My wife wanted to speak with the hotel's general manager. The lady we spoke with acknowledged all the shortcomings, apologized, and said that all deficiencies would be rectified next year, explaining that they had to open the hotel very quickly this year. However, we still haven't received any offer from the person we consider the most senior figure at the hotel – perhaps a room change or even a suggestion to compensate for the two days we lost – for this negative experience. My wife and I are two managers who have worked in the service industry for many years and can truly distinguish between good and bad. Nothing I've written is exaggerated or written from a dissatisfied perspective. Because we work in the industry, we may see everything in much greater detail. But it's unacceptable for anyone to receive this kind of service for the price they paid.

As an employee, my money is stuck inside, they're not paying it, I've become a beggar for the fruits of my own labor. I've applied and complained to the relevant authorities, but they don't even bother to respond. It's definitely labor exploitation, excessive overtime, and a threat to my safety... I will add comments everywhere.

We stayed at Highlight Bodrum Hotel for a week and thoroughly enjoyed every moment. One of the most impressive aspects of the hotel was definitely the sea – pristine, clear, and peaceful. Even swimming in the sea early in the morning was a pleasure in itself. The food was delicious; we were particularly pleased with the variety and flavors offered at dinner. Thanks to the meals prepared with fresh ingredients every day, we never felt the need to leave the hotel. The staff was also one of the most important factors that made this beautiful experience unforgettable. All the employees were extremely friendly, helpful, and did their jobs with great care. They took great care in fulfilling our every request and made us feel truly special. Highlight Bodrum is definitely a place I can recommend to anyone looking for a peaceful and high-quality holiday. Looking forward to seeing you again soon!

We bought the two most expensive loft rooms with jacuzzis. But they gave us standard rooms, saying they weren't available, and we paid 2500 TL extra each time!!! They haven't refunded our money either. They claim the room has a sea view when it doesn't; it's a joke. In reality, there isn't even a jacuzzi in the bathroom, but the photo of the room they sold showed a sea view jacuzzi. It's definitely a scam; 5000 TL wasted.

Odalar loş değil karanlık, sıcak su içi duşta 10 dakika bekliyorsunuz ayrıca duştan ve lavabodan gelen kokuya dayanmak zorundasınız. Oda temizliği vasat, odadan çıkarken temizlik için kart asmamıza rağmen akşam geldiğimizde odamız bıraktığımız gibiydi. Oda kahvaltıyı 5 dakika kaçırmam benim hatam fakat bu hatayı 150tl ye yakın bir ödemeyle sizden alıyorlar ve ayrıca verilen kahvaltının maliyeti 10tl bile değil. Söyleyebiliceğim tek pozitif yorum denizin çok güzel olması ki bu otelin hizmet ve kalitesiyle alakalı değil bulunduğu koy'un mükemmel olmasından dolayıdır. X beach yönetimi politikasını derhal değiştirmesi gerek. Şezlonglar o kadar yakın ki birbirine yan tarafın yaptığı dedikodu ve bebek bezi kokusuyla güneşlenmek zorunda kalıyosunuz. Herşey para değil müşteri memnuniyeti en önemlisidir paradan ama bu müessese de değil.

Plaji ise parasi olan herkesin alindigi bir plaj. Sezlonglr dip dibe... Soyunma kabinleri o kadar pis ve kotu kokuyor ki kalkip da degistiremedik mayolarimizi. Odedigimiz paraya karsilik aldigimiz hizmet cok cok kotuydu, dayanamayip iki gunluk paramizin yanmasini goze alarak baska bir otele gecis yaptik. Olumlu olarak soyleyebilecegim tek sey plaj kismindaki servisin sasirtici derecede hizli olusuydu...

Otelde konaklama yapmadığım için , sizlerle sadece günlük olarak kullandığım , otele ait olan X Beach ile ilgili yaşamış olduğum berbat tecrübemi paylaşmak isterim . Evim Yalıkavak ta olduğu için , deniz imkanından yararlanabilmek adına , evimede yakın olması nedeniyle X Beach e gitmek istedim . Gitmeden evvel telefonla arayarak günlük ücret ve alacağım hizmet konusunda bilgi rica ettim . Hatta Esra Hanım isimli görevli hanım , bana aylık girişlerim için indirimli bir fiyat bile verdi . Girişte alınan ücretin , içeride olan kullanımıma istinaden yansıtılacağını ı ve eğer fazla miktarda kullanım yaparsam üzerini ödemem gerektiği bilgisini verdi . Bu konu ile ilgili ise defalarca üst yönetimiyle görüşerek , onay aldığını belirterek , bana geri döndü . Ben oraya gittiğimde ise Esra Hanım işten ayrıldı , böyle bir uygulamamız yok diyerek , son derece ilgisiz , son derece profesyonel olmayan , sorumlu kişilerden servis yapan personele kadar , kapı girişinde bile bir hoşgeldiniz / güle güle denmeden karşılanıp uğurlanarak , hiç hoşnut kalmadığım bir kumsalda , anormal astronomik fiyatlarla berbat bir gün geçirdim . Keşke en azından ödediğim paranın karşılığını alabilmiş olsaydım . Otoparkı ise her şeyden daha beter . Arabamı kendim park etmiş olmama rağmen , kapıya yazılan bir " vale servisimiz ücretlidir " yazısına istinaden ücret ödemek zorunda kalmam ve saygısız davranışlı personelininde , aldıkları ücrete karşılık fiş bile vermedikleri için en azından yetkililerce denetlenmesi gerektiğini düşünüyorum . Bodrum ' da verilen paranın karşılığını alabileceğiniz bir çok işletme var iken bu tarz beach lerin kullanılmaması gerektiğini düşünüyorum .
